description: The file contains integration tests for the Delete functionality of the Articles feature in a conduit application, including tests for deleting articles, articles with tags, and articles with comments.

classes.name: DeleteTests
classes.description: Integration tests class for testing delete operations on articles, including scenarios with tags and comments.

methods.name: Expect_Delete_Article
methods.description: Test for deleting a simple article and verifying its removal from the database.

methods.name: Expect_Delete_Article_With_Tags
methods.description: Test for deleting an article that has associated tags, verifying removal.

methods.name: Expect_Delete_Article_With_Comments
methods.description: Test for deleting an article with associated comments and verifying its removal.
